profile.name: Maria Petrova
profile.title: Secondary Mathematics Teacher
profile.tagline: Making abstract mathematics concrete for every learner.
profile.summary: Twelve years of classroom experience in secondary mathematics, with a focus on inquiry-based learning and supporting students who arrive believing they are “not maths people”. National olympiad coach and author of an open-licensed problem set used in 40+ schools.

education.notes: Thesis on misconception patterns in early algebra.

bullets: Lead a team of nine teachers; redesigned the grades 8-10 curriculum around problem-based units.
Raised the share of students achieving the top matriculation band from 31% to 48% over three years.
Introduced a weekly peer-observation cycle now adopted school-wide.
Taught IB Mathematics HL/SL and national curriculum grades 9-12.
Founded the school's olympiad club, growing it from 6 to 45 participants.

practice.title: Quadratics through modelling

practice.description: A six-lesson unit in which students fit quadratic models to a dataset they collect themselves, then defend the model they chose.
